notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello bots! I made a small update that adds simple options menu.

The menu is available by pressing menu button of the left controller. Now you can set:

graphics quality (low, medium, high)
Angle of the weapon 
background music switch (on/off)

You can see a video here: http://rebotgame.gamesandapps.it/2018/01/07/new-options-menu/

byez!

notes.title: Working hard on the first update!
notes.notes:
Hello bots

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31186548/2fb6abc400cfde6ac7452238a12b35e2deba2ec7.jpg

We working hard on first update, in progress:

New enemies
new animations (for items like weapons, enemies deaths and more)
new and improved textures
Add new modes (one weapon challenge, infinite wave, no shield and more)
add end wave boss.
fix bugs!


We hope to release this "medium update" by March 1st



Byez!
